description: §22.4.1 (S460 "n4 b") — compile-time `emit()` output is the author's markup: a control named like an HTMLFormElement member (`name`, `action`) inside an emitted `<form>` is admitted, as the same form is in source. (Was meta-emit-form-member-name-neg, S459 round 4 F2.) The runtime refusal of the same markup is meta-emit-runtime-form-member-name-rt.
rationale: §22.4.1: the *Named properties* rule holds in compile-time `emit()` output for its `document` half only; the form half is a run-time rule (§22.12). Compile-time refusals stay a subset of run-time refusals. (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "n4 b")
